'''''Carex fedia''''' is a [[Bunch grass|tussock]]-forming species of perennial [[Carex|sedge]] in the family [[Cyperaceae]]. It is native to parts of [[Asia]] from [[Tajikistan]] in the west through to [[Vietnam]] in the east.<ref name=kew>{{cite web |url=https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:299710-1|title=''Carex fedia'' Nees |access-date=8 September 2022 |publisher=Kew Science – Plants of the World Online}}</ref>
